name: nubank-card
_note: Nubank card CSV, verified against real statements 2025-01..2025-12. Expenses are listed positive; sign -1 normalizes to negative=expense, which also turns a 'Pagamento recebido' line (written '- 839,46') into a credit. Amounts are Brazilian, i.e. 1.234,56, and are quoted because the delimiter is also a comma: parsing them as dot-decimal multiplied every plain amount by 100 (26,00 -> 2600.00) while dividing every amount with a thousands separator by about 1000 (1.234,56 -> 1.23).
